questions.solution_md:
$OM\perp AB$ o'tkazamiz. Markazdan vatarga tushirilgan perpendikulyar vatarni teng ikkiga bo'ladi: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=9$.

a) To'g'ri burchakli $OMA$ uchburchakdan $OM=\sqrt{OA^2-AM^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

b) $S(AOB)=\dfrac12\cdot AB\cdot OM=\dfrac12\cdot 18\cdot 12=108$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Pifagor teoremasiga vatarning o'zini ($AB$) qo'yish; to'g'risi — uning yarmi $AM$. Yuzni hisoblashda $\dfrac12$ ni unutish.

en.solution_md:

en.mistake_note_md: Putting the whole chord $AB$ into the Pythagorean theorem instead of its half $AM$; forgetting the factor $\dfrac12$ in the area.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=20$.

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Значит, $PA+PB=40$ см.

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $15$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=25$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 15, OP = 25.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=20$.

So $PA+PB=40$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=15$ sm, $AB=16$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, ya'ni $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=9$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 15) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 16).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, то есть $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=9$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, i.e. $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Discriminant: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=9$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

$OM\perp AB$ júrgizemiz. Orayınan xordaǵa túsirilgen perpendikulyar xordanı teń ekige bóledi: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=4$.

a) Tuwrımúyeshli $OMA$ úshmúyeshlikten $OM=\sqrt{OA^2-AM^2}=\sqrt{5^2-4^2}=3$.

Draw $OM\perp AB$. The perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects it: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=4$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, ya'ni $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=2$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, то есть $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=2$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, ya'ni $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=16$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, то есть $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=16$ см.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, i.e. $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Discriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=16$ cm.

kaa.solution_md:
Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=12$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=12$.

Demek, $PA+PB=24$ sm.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $5$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=13$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 5, OP = 13.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=12$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=12$.

So $PA+PB=24$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=6$ sm, $AB=9$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, ya'ni $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=3$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=6$ см, $AB=9$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 6) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 9).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, то есть $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=3$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, i.e. $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Discriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=3$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.solution_md:
$OM\perp AB$ o'tkazamiz. Markazdan vatarga tushirilgan perpendikulyar vatarni teng ikkiga bo'ladi: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=8$.

a) To'g'ri burchakli $OMA$ uchburchakdan $OM=\sqrt{OA^2-AM^2}=\sqrt{10^2-8^2}=6$.

b) $S(AOB)=\dfrac12\cdot AB\cdot OM=\dfrac12\cdot 16\cdot 6=48$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Pifagor teoremasiga vatarning o'zini ($AB$) qo'yish; to'g'risi — uning yarmi $AM$. Yuzni hisoblashda $\dfrac12$ ni unutish.

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=8$ sm, $AB=12$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+12$.

$x(x+12)=8^2=64$, ya'ni $x^2+12x-64=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=12^2+4\cdot 64=400$, $\sqrt{D}=20$, $x=\dfrac{-12+20}{2}=4$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=4$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+12$.

$x(x+12)=8^2=64$, то есть $x^2+12x-64=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=12^2+4\cdot 64=400$, $\sqrt{D}=20$, $x=\dfrac{-12+20}{2}=4$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=4$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 8, OP = 17.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{17^2-8^2}=15$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=15$.

So $PA+PB=30$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=12$ sm, $AB=10$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+10$.

$x(x+10)=12^2=144$, ya'ni $x^2+10x-144=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=10^2+4\cdot 144=676$, $\sqrt{D}=26$, $x=\dfrac{-10+26}{2}=8$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=8$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+10$.

$x(x+10)=12^2=144$, то есть $x^2+10x-144=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=10^2+4\cdot 144=676$, $\sqrt{D}=26$, $x=\dfrac{-10+26}{2}=8$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=8$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+10$.

$x(x+10)=12^2=144$, i.e. $x^2+10x-144=0$.

Discriminant: $D=10^2+4\cdot 144=676$, $\sqrt{D}=26$, $x=\dfrac{-10+26}{2}=8$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=8$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

kaa.solution_md:
$OM\perp AB$ júrgizemiz. Orayınan xordaǵa túsirilgen perpendikulyar xordanı teń ekige bóledi: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=15$.

a) Tuwrımúyeshli $OMA$ úshmúyeshlikten $OM=\sqrt{OA^2-AM^2}=\sqrt{17^2-15^2}=8$.

b) $S(AOB)=\dfrac12\cdot AB\cdot OM=\dfrac12\cdot 30\cdot 8=120$.

Draw $OM\perp AB$. The perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects it: $AM=\dfrac{AB}{2}=15$.

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $7$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=25$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-7^2}=24$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=24$.

So $PA+PB=48$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=12$ sm, $AB=7$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+7$.

$x(x+7)=12^2=144$, ya'ni $x^2+7x-144=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=7^2+4\cdot 144=625$, $\sqrt{D}=25$, $x=\dfrac{-7+25}{2}=9$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=9$ sm.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=12$ см, $AB=7$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="194.9" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="236.2" y2="176.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="194.9" y1="110" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="139.8,68.4 134.4,75.6 127.2,70.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="153.5" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="236.2" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="132.6" cy="63" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="33.4" y="182.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="146.1" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="243.7" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="120.7" y="53.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="79.5" y="111.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="194.9" y="202.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">7</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 12) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 7).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+7$.

$x(x+7)=12^2=144$, то есть $x^2+7x-144=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=7^2+4\cdot 144=625$, $\sqrt{D}=25$, $x=\dfrac{-7+25}{2}=9$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=9$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=8$.

Demak, $PA+PB=16$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat bitta urinma kesmasini topib, ikkinchisini qo'shishni unutish yoki $PA=OP-OA$ deb olish (Pifagor teoremasi kerak).

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=8$.

Значит, $PA+PB=16$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=8$.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $6$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=10$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="264" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="174.2,56.4 183,63 189.6,54.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="174.2,163.6 183,157 189.6,165.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="120" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="279" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="189.8" y="35.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="189.8" y="184.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="144.7" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="235.4" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 6, OP = 10.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=8$.

So $PA+PB=16$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=15$ sm, $AB=16$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="184.8" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="244.8" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="184.8" y1="110" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="127.5,71.5 122.5,79 115,73.9" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="124.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="244.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="120" cy="66.5" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="43.3" y="165.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="114" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="255.5" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="107.6" y="58.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="77.8" y="105.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text><text x="184.8" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">16</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 15) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 16).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, ya'ni $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=9$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=15$ см, $AB=16$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="184.8" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="244.8" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="184.8" y1="110" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="127.5,71.5 122.5,79 115,73.9" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="124.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="244.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="120" cy="66.5" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="43.3" y="165.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="114" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="255.5" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="107.6" y="58.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="77.8" y="105.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text><text x="184.8" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">16</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 15) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 16).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, то есть $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=9$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=15$ cm, $AB=16$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="184.8" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="244.8" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="57.3" y1="159.8" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="184.8" y1="110" x2="120" y2="66.5" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="127.5,71.5 122.5,79 115,73.9" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="124.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="244.8" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="120" cy="66.5" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="43.3" y="165.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="114" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="255.5" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="107.6" y="58.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="77.8" y="105.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text><text x="184.8" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">16</text></svg>
figure.alt: From the point P a tangent PT (PT = 15) and a secant through A and B (AB = 16) are drawn to the circle.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+16$.

$x(x+16)=15^2=225$, i.e. $x^2+16x-225=0$.

Discriminant: $D=16^2+4\cdot 225=1156$, $\sqrt{D}=34$, $x=\dfrac{-16+34}{2}=9$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=9$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.stem_md: $O$ markazli aylananing radiusi $9$ sm. Aylanadan tashqaridagi $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PA$ va $PB$ urinmalar o'tkazilgan ($A$ va $B$ — urinish nuqtalari), $OP=15$ sm. $PA+PB$ yig'indini (sm da) toping.

figure.alt: O markazli aylana, tashqaridagi P nuqtadan PA va PB urinmalar; radius 9, OP = 15.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=12$.

Demak, $PA+PB=24$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat bitta urinma kesmasini topib, ikkinchisini qo'shishni unutish yoki $PA=OP-OA$ deb olish (Pifagor teoremasi kerak).

figure.alt: Окружность с центром O, из внешней точки P проведены касательные PA и PB; радиус 9, OP = 15.

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=12$.

Значит, $PA+PB=24$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=12$.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $9$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=15$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="264" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="174.2,56.4 183,63 189.6,54.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="174.2,163.6 183,157 189.6,165.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="120" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="279" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="189.8" y="35.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="189.8" y="184.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="144.7" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="235.4" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 9, OP = 15.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=12$.

So $PA+PB=24$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=4$ sm, $AB=6$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 4) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 6).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, ya'ni $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=2$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=4$ см, $AB=6$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 4) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 6).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, то есть $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=2$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

kaa.stem_md: $P$ noqattan sheńberge $PT$ urınba ($T$ — urınıw noqatı) hám sheńberdi $A$ hám $B$ noqatlarında keship ótetuǵın kesiwshi júrgizilgen ($A$ noqat $P$ ǵa jaqın). $PT=4$ sm, $AB=6$ sm. $PA$ kesindiniń uzınlıǵın (sm de) tabıń.

kaa.solution_md:
Urınba hám kesiwshi teoreması: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desek, $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, yaǵnıy $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (teris túbir jaramaydı).

Juwap: $PA=2$ sm.

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=20$ sm, $AB=9$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, ya'ni $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=16$ sm.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, то есть $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Ответ: $PA=16$ см.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{20^2-12^2}=16$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=16$.

Demak, $PA+PB=32$ sm.

ru.stem_md: Радиус окружности с центром $O$ равен $12$ см. Из точки $P$ вне окружности проведены касательные $PA$ и $PB$ ($A$ и $B$ — точки касания), $OP=20$ см. Найдите сумму $PA+PB$ (в см).

figure.alt: Окружность с центром O, из внешней точки P проведены касательные PA и PB; радиус 12, OP = 20.

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{20^2-12^2}=16$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=16$.

Значит, $PA+PB=32$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

kaa.solution_md:
Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{20^2-12^2}=16$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=16$.

Demek, $PA+PB=32$ sm.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $12$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=20$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="264" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="174.2,56.4 183,63 189.6,54.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="174.2,163.6 183,157 189.6,165.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="120" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="279" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="189.8" y="35.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="189.8" y="184.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="144.7" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="235.4" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">20</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 12, OP = 20.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{20^2-12^2}=16$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=16$.

So $PA+PB=32$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=6$ sm, $AB=9$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 6) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 9).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, ya'ni $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=3$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=6$ см, $AB=9$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 6) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 9).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, то есть $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=3$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

kaa.stem_md: $P$ noqattan sheńberge $PT$ urınba ($T$ — urınıw noqatı) hám sheńberdi $A$ hám $B$ noqatlarında keship ótetuǵın kesiwshi júrgizilgen ($A$ noqat $P$ ǵa jaqın). $PT=6$ sm, $AB=9$ sm. $PA$ kesindiniń uzınlıǵın (sm de) tabıń.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, yaǵnıy $x^2+9x-36=0$.

en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=6$ cm, $AB=9$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: From the point P a tangent PT (PT = 6) and a secant through A and B (AB = 9) are drawn to the circle.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, i.e. $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Discriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=3$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.stem_md: $O$ markazli aylananing radiusi $10$ sm. Aylanadan tashqaridagi $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PA$ va $PB$ urinmalar o'tkazilgan ($A$ va $B$ — urinish nuqtalari), $OP=26$ sm. $PA+PB$ yig'indini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{26^2-10^2}=24$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=24$.

Demak, $PA+PB=48$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat bitta urinma kesmasini topib, ikkinchisini qo'shishni unutish yoki $PA=OP-OA$ deb olish (Pifagor teoremasi kerak).

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{26^2-10^2}=24$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=24$.

Значит, $PA+PB=48$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{26^2-10^2}=24$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=24$.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $10$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=26$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="103.1" cy="110" r="71.1" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="288" y1="110" x2="130.5" y2="44.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="288" y1="110" x2="130.5" y2="175.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="103.1" y1="110" x2="130.5" y2="44.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="103.1" y1="110" x2="130.5" y2="175.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="103.1" y1="110" x2="288" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="126.2,54.5 136.4,58.7 140.6,48.6" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="126.2,165.5 136.4,161.3 140.6,171.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="103.1" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="89.1" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="303" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="136.2" y="30.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="136.2" y="189.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="103.4" y="75.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text><text x="247.3" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">26</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 10, OP = 26.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{26^2-10^2}=24$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=24$.

So $PA+PB=48$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=8$ sm, $AB=12$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 8) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 12).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+12$.

$x(x+12)=8^2=64$, ya'ni $x^2+12x-64=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=12^2+4\cdot 64=400$, $\sqrt{D}=20$, $x=\dfrac{-12+20}{2}=4$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=4$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=8$ см, $AB=12$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 8) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 12).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+12$.

$x(x+12)=8^2=64$, то есть $x^2+12x-64=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=12^2+4\cdot 64=400$, $\sqrt{D}=20$, $x=\dfrac{-12+20}{2}=4$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=4$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

kaa.stem_md: $P$ noqattan sheńberge $PT$ urınba ($T$ — urınıw noqatı) hám sheńberdi $A$ hám $B$ noqatlarında keship ótetuǵın kesiwshi júrgizilgen ($A$ noqat $P$ ǵa jaqın). $PT=8$ sm, $AB=12$ sm. $PA$ kesindiniń uzınlıǵın (sm de) tabıń.

en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=8$ cm, $AB=12$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="171" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="231" y2="159.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="71" y1="159.8" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="171" y1="110" x2="97.4" y2="84.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="105.9,87.3 102.9,95.8 94.4,92.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="111" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="231" cy="159.8" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="97.4" cy="84.3" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="57.6" y="166.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="100.2" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="241.8" y="168.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="83.2" y="79.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="71.9" y="117.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="171" y="185.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: From the point P a tangent PT (PT = 8) and a secant through A and B (AB = 12) are drawn to the circle.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+12$.

$x(x+12)=8^2=64$, i.e. $x^2+12x-64=0$.

Discriminant: $D=12^2+4\cdot 64=400$, $\sqrt{D}=20$, $x=\dfrac{-12+20}{2}=4$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=4$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=12$ sm, $AB=10$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+10$.

$x(x+10)=12^2=144$, ya'ni $x^2+10x-144=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=10^2+4\cdot 144=676$, $\sqrt{D}=26$, $x=\dfrac{-10+26}{2}=8$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=8$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+10$.

$x(x+10)=12^2=144$, то есть $x^2+10x-144=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=10^2+4\cdot 144=676$, $\sqrt{D}=26$, $x=\dfrac{-10+26}{2}=8$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=8$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=20$.

Значит, $PA+PB=40$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

kaa.stem_md: Orayı $O$ bolǵan sheńberdiń radiusı $15$ sm. Sheńberden sırttaǵı $P$ noqattan sheńberge $PA$ hám $PB$ urınbaları júrgizilgen ($A$ hám $B$ — urınıw noqatları), $OP=25$ sm. $PA+PB$ jıyındısın (sm de) tabıń.

kaa.solution_md:
Urınba urınıw noqatına júrgizilgen radiusqa perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. Tuwrımúyeshli $OAP$ úshmúyeshlikten $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Sırtqı noqattan júrgizilgen urınba kesindileri teń: $PB=PA=20$.

Demek, $PA+PB=40$ sm.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek bir urınba kesindisin tabıp, ekinshisin qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa $PA=OP-OA$ dep alıw (Pifagor teoreması kerek).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $15$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=25$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="264" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="47.6" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="180.8" y2="172.4" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="134" y1="110" x2="264" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="174.2,56.4 183,63 189.6,54.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="174.2,163.6 183,157 189.6,165.8" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="134" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="120" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="279" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="189.8" y="35.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="189.8" y="184.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="144.7" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text><text x="235.4" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">25</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 15, OP = 25.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=20$.

So $PA+PB=40$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=12$ sm, $AB=7$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="194.9" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="236.2" y2="176.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="194.9" y1="110" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="139.8,68.4 134.4,75.6 127.2,70.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="153.5" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="236.2" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="132.6" cy="63" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="33.4" y="182.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="146.1" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="243.7" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="120.7" y="53.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="79.5" y="111.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="194.9" y="202.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">7</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 12) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 7).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+7$.

$x(x+7)=12^2=144$, ya'ni $x^2+7x-144=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=7^2+4\cdot 144=625$, $\sqrt{D}=25$, $x=\dfrac{-7+25}{2}=9$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=9$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=12$ см, $AB=7$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="194.9" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="236.2" y2="176.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="47.1" y1="176.1" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="194.9" y1="110" x2="132.6" y2="63" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="139.8,68.4 134.4,75.6 127.2,70.2" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="153.5" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="236.2" cy="176.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="132.6" cy="63" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="33.4" y="182.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="146.1" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="243.7" y="188" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="120.7" y="53.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="79.5" y="111.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="194.9" y="202.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">7</text></svg>
figure.alt: Из точки P к окружности проведены касательная PT (PT = 12) и секущая через точки A и B (AB = 7).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+7$.

$x(x+7)=12^2=144$, то есть $x^2+7x-144=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=7^2+4\cdot 144=625$, $\sqrt{D}=25$, $x=\dfrac{-7+25}{2}=9$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=9$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=12$ cm, $AB=7$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+7$.

$x(x+7)=12^2=144$, i.e. $x^2+7x-144=0$.

Discriminant: $D=7^2+4\cdot 144=625$, $\sqrt{D}=25$, $x=\dfrac{-7+25}{2}=9$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=9$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.stem_md: $O$ markazli aylananing radiusi $3$ sm. Aylanadan tashqaridagi $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PA$ va $PB$ urinmalar o'tkazilgan ($A$ va $B$ — urinish nuqtalari), $OP=5$ sm. $PA+PB$ yig'indini (sm da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

Tashqi nuqtadan o'tkazilgan urinma kesmalari teng: $PB=PA=4$.

Demak, $PA+PB=8$ sm.

ru.stem_md: Радиус окружности с центром $O$ равен $3$ см. Из точки $P$ вне окружности проведены касательные $PA$ и $PB$ ($A$ и $B$ — точки касания), $OP=5$ см. Найдите сумму $PA+PB$ (в см).

ru.solution_md:
Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

Отрезки касательных, проведённых из одной точки, равны: $PB=PA=4$.

Значит, $PA+PB=8$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только один отрезок касательной и забывают второй, либо считают $PA=OP-OA$ (нужна теорема Пифагора).

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $3$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=5$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, ya'ni $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=2$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки $P$ к окружности проведены касательная $PT$ ($T$ — точка касания) и секущая, пересекающая окружность в точках $A$ и $B$ (точка $A$ ближе к $P$). $PT=4$ см, $AB=6$ см. Найдите длину отрезка $PA$ (в см).

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, то есть $x^2+6x-16=0$.

Дискриминант: $D=6^2+4\cdot 16=100$, $\sqrt{D}=10$, $x=\dfrac{-6+10}{2}=2$ (отрицательный корень не подходит).

Ответ: $PA=2$ см.
ru.mistake_note_md: Записывают теорему как $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (забыв квадрат) либо находят $PB$ и выдают его за $PA$.

Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+6$.

$x(x+6)=4^2=16$, i.e. $x^2+6x-16=0$.

questions.solution_md:
Urinma urinish nuqtasiga o'tkazilgan radiusga perpendikulyar: $OA\perp PA$. To'g'ri burchakli $OAP$ uchburchakdan $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{17^2-8^2}=15$.

Касательная перпендикулярна радиусу, проведённому в точку касания: $OA\perp PA$. Из прямоугольного треугольника $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{17^2-8^2}=15$.

en.stem_md: The circle with center $O$ has radius $8$ cm. From a point $P$ outside the circle the tangents $PA$ and $PB$ are drawn ($A$ and $B$ are the points of tangency), $OP=17$ cm. Find $PA+PB$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="116.1" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="281.9" y1="110" x2="152.8" y2="41.2" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="281.9" y1="110" x2="152.8" y2="178.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="116.1" y1="110" x2="152.8" y2="41.2" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="116.1" y1="110" x2="152.8" y2="178.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="116.1" y1="110" x2="281.9" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="147.7,50.9 157.4,56.1 162.5,46.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><polyline points="147.7,169.1 157.4,163.9 162.5,173.6" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="116.1" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="102.1" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="296.9" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="159.9" y="27.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="159.9" y="192.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="121.2" y="72.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="245.4" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">17</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and tangents PA and PB from the outside point P; radius 8, OP = 17.

en.solution_md:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency: $OA\perp PA$. From right triangle $OAP$: $PA=\sqrt{OP^2-OA^2}=\sqrt{17^2-8^2}=15$.

Tangent segments drawn from one point are equal: $PB=PA=15$.

So $PA+PB=30$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Finding only one tangent segment and forgetting the second, or taking $PA=OP-OA$ (the Pythagorean theorem is needed).

questions.stem_md: $P$ nuqtadan aylanaga $PT$ urinma ($T$ — urinish nuqtasi) va aylanani $A$ hamda $B$ nuqtalarda kesuvchi to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazilgan ($A$ nuqta $P$ ga yaqin). $PT=20$ sm, $AB=9$ sm. $PA$ kesmaning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="193.7" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="48.3" y1="181.2" x2="225.6" y2="181.2" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="48.3" y1="181.2" x2="129.9" y2="65.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="193.7" y1="110" x2="129.9" y2="65.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="137.2,70.3 132.1,77.7 124.7,72.5" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="161.8" cy="181.2" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="225.6" cy="181.2" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="129.9" cy="65.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="34.8" y="187.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="156" y="193.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="231.3" y="193.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="117.6" y="56.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="78.5" y="115.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">20</text><text x="193.7" y="207.2" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: P nuqtadan aylanaga PT urinma (PT = 20) va A, B nuqtalarda kesuvchi (AB = 9).

questions.solution_md:
Urinma va kesuvchi teoremasi: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desak, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, ya'ni $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (manfiy ildiz yaramaydi).

Javob: $PA=16$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teoremani $PT=PA\cdot PB$ deb yozish (kvadratni unutish) yoki $PB$ ni topib, uni $PA$ deb javob sifatida yozib qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Теорема о касательной и секущей: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Пусть $PA=x$, тогда $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, то есть $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Ответ: $PA=16$ см.
