en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=20$ cm, $AB=9$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="193.7" cy="110" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="48.3" y1="181.2" x2="225.6" y2="181.2" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="48.3" y1="181.2" x2="129.9" y2="65.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="193.7" y1="110" x2="129.9" y2="65.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="137.2,70.3 132.1,77.7 124.7,72.5" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><circle cx="161.8" cy="181.2" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="225.6" cy="181.2" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="129.9" cy="65.1" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="34.8" y="187.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">P</text><text x="156" y="193.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="231.3" y="193.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="117.6" y="56.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">T</text><text x="78.5" y="115.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">20</text><text x="193.7" y="207.2" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: From the point P a tangent PT (PT = 20) and a secant through A and B (AB = 9) are drawn to the circle.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=20^2=400$, i.e. $x^2+9x-400=0$.

Discriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 400=1681$, $\sqrt{D}=41$, $x=\dfrac{-9+41}{2}=16$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=16$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

kaa.solution_md:
Urınba hám kesiwshi teoreması: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. $PA=x$ desek, $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, yaǵnıy $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Diskriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (teris túbir jaramaydı).

Juwap: $PA=3$ sm.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Teoremanı $PT=PA\cdot PB$ dep jazıw (kvadratın umıtıw) yamasa $PB$ nı tabıp, onı $PA$ dep juwap etip jazıw.

en.stem_md: From a point $P$ a tangent $PT$ ($T$ is the point of tangency) and a secant meeting the circle at $A$ and $B$ ($A$ is nearer to $P$) are drawn. $PT=6$ cm, $AB=9$ cm. Find the length of $PA$ (in cm).

figure.alt: From the point P a tangent PT (PT = 6) and a secant through A and B (AB = 9) are drawn to the circle.

en.solution_md:
Tangent-secant theorem: $PT^2=PA\cdot PB$. Let $PA=x$, then $PB=x+9$.

$x(x+9)=6^2=36$, i.e. $x^2+9x-36=0$.

Discriminant: $D=9^2+4\cdot 36=225$, $\sqrt{D}=15$, $x=\dfrac{-9+15}{2}=3$ (the negative root is rejected).

Answer: $PA=3$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Writing the theorem as $PT=PA\cdot PB$ (forgetting the square) or finding $PB$ and reporting it as $PA$.

questions.stem_md: Aylanadan tashqaridagi nuqtadan urinma va kesuvchi o'tkazilgan. Urinma uzunligi $12$, kesuvchining tashqi qismi $2$. Kesuvchining butun uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md: $t^{2}=b\cdot x\Rightarrow 12^{2}=2\cdot x,\ x=72$ Javob: $72$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Urinma kvadratini kesuvchining ichki qismiga tenglab, butun kesuvchi o'rniga ichki qismni topish.

ru.stem_md: Из точки вне окружности проведены касательная и секущая. Длина касательной равна $12$, внешняя часть секущей — $2$. Найдите длину всей секущей.
ru.solution_md: $t^{2}=b\cdot x\Rightarrow 12^{2}=2\cdot x,\ x=72$ Ответ: $72$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Приравнивают квадрат касательной к внутренней части секущей и находят её вместо всей секущей.

kaa.stem_md: Sheńberden sırtqı noqattan urınba hám kesiwshi ótkerilgen. Urınba uzınlıǵı $12$, kesiwshiniń sırtqı bólegi $2$. Kesiwshiniń pútin uzınlıǵın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: $t^{2}=b\cdot x\Rightarrow 12^{2}=2\cdot x,\ x=72$ Juwap: $72$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Urınba kvadratın kesiwshiniń ishki bólegine teńlep, pútin kesiwshi ornına ishki bólekti tabıw.

en.stem_md: A tangent and a secant are drawn from a point outside a circle. The tangent has length $12$ and the external part of the secant is $2$. Find the whole secant.
en.solution_md: $t^{2}=b\cdot x\Rightarrow 12^{2}=2\cdot x,\ x=72$ Answer: $72$.
en.mistake_note_md: Setting the tangent squared equal to the inner part and finding it instead of the whole secant.

questions.stem_md: Aylananing ikki vatari kesishadi. Birinchi vatar kesishish nuqtasida $4$ va $8$ bo'laklarga bo'linadi, ikkinchisining bir bo'lagi $4$. Ikkinchi bo'lakni toping.
questions.solution_md: $4\cdot 8=4\cdot x\Rightarrow x=8$ Javob: $8$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Kesishuvchi vatarlar teoremasi o'rniga bo'laklarni qo'shish.

ru.stem_md: Две хорды окружности пересекаются. Первая делится точкой пересечения на отрезки $4$ и $8$, один из отрезков второй равен $4$. Найдите другой отрезок второй хорды.
ru.solution_md: $4\cdot 8=4\cdot x\Rightarrow x=8$ Ответ: $8$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Складывают отрезки вместо применения теоремы о пересекающихся хордах.

kaa.stem_md: Sheńberdiń eki xordası kesilisedi. Birinshi xorda kesilisiw noqatında $4$ hám $8$ bólekke bólinedi, ekinshisiniń bir bólegi $4$. Ekinshi bólekti tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: $4\cdot 8=4\cdot x\Rightarrow x=8$ Juwap: $8$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Kesilisiwshi xordalar teoreması ornına bóleklerdi qosıw.

en.stem_md: Two chords of a circle intersect. The first is divided into segments $4$ and $8$, and one segment of the second is $4$. Find the other segment of the second chord.
en.solution_md: $4\cdot 8=4\cdot x\Rightarrow x=8$ Answer: $8$.
en.mistake_note_md: Adding segments instead of using the intersecting-chords theorem.

questions.stem_md: Aylanadan tashqaridagi nuqtadan urinma va kesuvchi o'tkazilgan. Urinma uzunligi $7$, kesuvchining tashqi qismi $3$. Kesuvchining butun uzunligini toping.

ru.solution_md: $t^{2}=b\cdot x\Rightarrow 7^{2}=3\cdot x,\ x=\frac{49}{3}$ Ответ: $\frac{49}{3}$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Приравнивают квадрат касательной к внутренней части секущей и находят её вместо всей секущей.

kaa.stem_md: Sheńberden sırtqı noqattan urınba hám kesiwshi ótkerilgen. Urınba uzınlıǵı $7$, kesiwshiniń sırtqı bólegi $3$. Kesiwshiniń pútin uzınlıǵın tabıń.
